questions.question: Reasoning Puzzle #71: In a seating alignment of 96 candidates facing North, Priya is ranked 16th from left. Simultaneously, a runner travels 145 km North, turns East 214 km, then South 145 km. What is Priya's rank from right and runner's net displacement?
questions.hint: Rank from right = Total (96) - Left (16) + 1 = 81th. North/South movements cancel, leaving 214 km East.
